answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 13929 Country: India Title: What is minimum number of ayat are obligatory to recite in one rakat? is it minimum 3? Question: What is minimum number of ayat are obligatory to recite in one rakat? is it minimum 3? Answer ID: 13929 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 990/990=M/1430) Yes, the minimum obligatory amount of qirat (recitation of the Quran) in salah is three short verses or one long verse which is equal to three short verses: تجب قرأۃ الفاتحۃ و ضم السورۃ أو مایقوم مقامھا من ثلاث آیات قصار أو آیۃ طویلۃ في الأولیین بعد الفاتحۃ (الھندیۃ ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
